art.title: The Laughing Cavalier
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons
art.story: He is not really laughing, and nobody knows who he was. The painting says only that he was 26 in 1624. Frans Hals gives him a huge black hat, an upturned moustache, a lace collar and sleeves embroidered with arrows, bees and flames, signs of love that may mean it was painted for an engagement. Up close the lace and curls are just quick, loose strokes of the brush, which come together as you step back. The name "Laughing Cavalier" came two centuries later, when it became famous in London.
